text: There are a number of important consultations that the City is undertaking ahead of reports in the Fall. Of particular note is the upcoming consultation on the Noise By-Law, which encompasses a number of issues, on which residents are keen to give their input. Ensuring interested residents have an opportunity for their input is crucial to ensure a successful outcome that reflects the concerns of residents and stakeholders, and avoids the need to revise or redo the consultations if issues are raised by residents who did not have a chance to participate. While some limited consultations may be able to happen in the summer, ensuring that there is a robust consultation, including meeting options in the Fall is important to ensure the City reaches everybody.
Item MM8.21 was withdrawn at City Council on July 19 and 20, 2023.
